long_biography.plain_text:
In 2023, hotel entrepreneur Stefano Saviotti sold six Portuguese hotels and five Vilamoura golf courses after more than five decades at Dom Pedro. The transaction shifted most of the group's Portuguese resort estate to Arrow Global and ended Saviotti's direct ownership of properties that had shaped Madeira and Vilamoura.

Saviotti recognised golf's commercial potential after taking up the game and added course management to Dom Pedro's Vilamoura operations. The group then paired hotel stays with golf before that model was established in the Algarve. A 2016 acquisition of five championship courses turned a long management relationship into ownership. Loulé later named a street after him and awarded its gold municipal medal for his contribution to regional development.
